scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.test: JWT_SECRET=test-secret esbuild src/error-boundary.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:pg-native --outfile=dist/error-boundary.test.cjs --log-level=warning && NODE_ENV=production LOG_LEVEL=silent JWT_SECRET=test-secret node --test dist/error-boundary.test.cjs
scripts.test-patient-flow: pnpm --filter @workspace/db exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild scripts/test-patient-flow.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:pg-native --outfile=dist/test-patient-flow.cjs --log-level=warning && node dist/test-patient-flow.cjs
scripts.test-order-concurrency: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && esbuild scripts/test-order-concurrency.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:pg-native --outfile=dist/test-order-concurrency.cjs --log-level=warning && node dist/test-order-concurrency.cjs
